fact: Telma (AXIAN Telecom press release, 10 February 2023) states Madagascar has three existing international subsea cables, EASSy, LION and METISS, all reaching the country through Telma's national backbone; landing stations are not named for these three.

Madagascar Newsroom says Madagascar is linked by four submarine cables, Lion 1 and 2, EASSy (second international exit, at Toliara), METISS (24 Tbps, in service since March 2021, third exit at Fort Dauphin) and 2Africa (landed at Mahajanga in February 2023, 180 Tbps nominal).
